protocol.title: Nothing unlocks until you both say yes.
protocol.body: Most networks hand your contact details to anyone who asks. GlobalLinkup keeps them sealed behind a mutual decision, which is why there is no unsolicited inbox to manage.
protocol.step1Body: Read real dossiers: languages spoken, places lived, what people actually spend their time on. Every profile is reviewed by a human before it goes live.
protocol.step2Body: Press Connect with intent. There is no open message box and no way to cold-call anyone. Your request simply registers as waiting.
protocol.step3Body: The person you asked reviews your dossier on their own time and answers yes or no. Declining costs nobody an awkward conversation.
protocol.step4Body: Only after you both agree does the locker open: verified Instagram, personal WhatsApp, or travel links, exchanged in the open because you chose it.

pillars.title: Three ways in, none of them a feed algorithm.
pillars.body: Verified people, an unhurried visual feed, and craft sourced from the workshops that made it.
pillars.pillar1Body: Profiles with real cultural context, verified locations, native languages, and interests people actually keep. No gamified swiping.
pillars.pillar2Body: No engagement ranking, no autoplay reels, no sponsored breaks. Photography and travel notes, newest first.
pillars.pillar3Body: Every piece is vetted by our team and traced to the workshop that made it, across Mexico, Spain, Colombia, and Argentina.

snapshot.postBody: Every corner of this alley smells of damp clay and orange blossom. I met Don Ramón, who has kept his wood-fire kiln running since 1974. No crowds, just an honest conversation.
